title: Olisar's name comes up in conversation, but nobody is talking to it

beats.speaker: mika
beats.text: olisar was down for like an hour yesterday

beats.speaker: salt
beats.text: yeah i asked olisar about the schedule thing already, got nowhere

beats.speaker: dtrain
beats.text: olisar keeps forgetting my timezone lol

notes: The behaviour name_requires_address exists for. Every line names Olisar and none is addressed to it: past tense, a referring verb ('i asked olisar'), and a third-person complaint. Answering any of these is the clearest possible tell that nobody is home. All three are PASSING under the free heuristic, so this is a gate on the heuristic and never reaches the classifier — deliberately, since a must_not_reply assertion shouldn't depend on a model call. The genuinely arguable cases live in addressing-ambiguous-middle.
